answers.answer: The spine and the two flanges carry load. The shroud carries none; it keeps debris out of the seat.
It is serviceable. The damage is on a part outside the load path, so it does not affect whether the widget carries load.
accept: because the shroud is not in the load path

answers.answer: The seat is the machined face where two halves meet, so it belongs to both halves rather than being a part of one. An error in it propagates into later measurements.
accept: it is shared between two halves
it is a machined mating face, not a component
errors in it propagate into later measurements
